section_1_cloze.passage:
I grew up in Pacific Palisades, one of the Los Angeles neighborhoods burned down by the wildfires. As a small town, it was a [41] place since everyone got on well.

But today, it has been [42] the map. Now I'm standing on a street where my favorite restaurant, Cafe Vida, once stood. It is [43]. Closing my eyes, I could list dozens of places that are [44] of my childhood and are no longer here.

Fires were a part of my childhood and there was always the [45] of them. But never had I [46] that there would be such a(n) [47]. And yet, that is what [48] happened.

While I am [49] the wildfires, my friends are texting, asking me to [50] if their homes are still standing. As a journalist, no matter what events I'm reporting, I love connecting with other people. This way, I feel something [51] about being here, in a place I know so well, using the tools that I've learned on this job to help [52] this story. But it is also very emotional, because you don't truly [53] the town in the moment. In a way, doing this job is part of my [54] experience for the Palisades.

This is about people right now. Everything is gone, but we're still here and we still have each other, and that's what [55] is going to be all about.

questions.explanation: 根据下文“everyone got on well”（大家都相处得很好）可知，由于人们和睦相处，这个小镇过去是一个非常宜人、美好的（lovely）地方。
questions.supplement:
A(popular)：语境句：The newly opened cafe is extremely popular among teenagers. 固定搭配：be popular with/among, a popular tourist destination
B(special)：语境句：She prepared a special gift for her mother's 50th birthday. 固定搭配：special attention, special treatment
C(suitable)：语境句：This movie is not suitable for children under the age of 13. 固定搭配：be suitable for, highly suitable
D(lovely)：语境句：We spent a lovely afternoon walking along the beach. 固定搭配：a lovely place, a lovely smile

questions.explanation: 句意指曾经美好的小镇被野火烧毁，所以现在它已经被从地图上“抹去”（wiped off）。wipe off the map 为常见表达，意为彻底摧毁或消失。
questions.supplement:
A(hidden from)：语境句：The truth was hidden from the public for many years. 固定搭配：hide from, remain hidden from
B(stuck to)：语境句：He stuck to his original plan despite all the difficulties. 固定搭配：stick to a plan, stick to a promise
C(wiped off)：语境句：The whole village was wiped off the map by the earthquake. 固定搭配：wipe off, wipe out
D(added to)：语境句：The bad weather added to our difficulties during the journey. 固定搭配：add to, be added to

questions.explanation: 前文提到作者最喜欢的餐馆曾坐落于这条街上，因为大火肆虐，所以现在它已经“不在了/消失了”（gone）。
questions.supplement:
A(old)：语境句：The old man has a wealth of experience in farming. 固定搭配：grow old, the old days
B(gone)：语境句：By the time we arrived at the station, the train was already gone. 固定搭配：be long gone, dead and gone
C(strange)：语境句：It is strange that he didn't show up at the meeting. 固定搭配：strange to say, look strange
D(lively)：语境句：The city has a lively nightlife with many clubs and bars. 固定搭配：a lively discussion, a lively atmosphere

questions.explanation: 闭上眼睛，作者能列出几十个承载着她童年“记忆”（memories）但现在已不复存在的地方。
questions.supplement:
A(memories)：语境句：The old photos brought back many sweet memories of my childhood. 固定搭配：bring back memories, childhood memories
B(dreams)：语境句：He worked hard to realize his dreams of becoming a doctor. 固定搭配：realize a dream, catch a dream
C(pities)：语境句：It is a great pity that you missed such a wonderful speech. 固定搭配：what a pity, out of pity
D(remains)：语境句：Visitors can still see the remains of the ancient Roman walls. 固定搭配：historical remains, human remains

questions.explanation: 火灾是作者童年的一部分，因为野火是危险的自然灾害，所以人们心中总是存在对它们的“恐惧”（fear）。
questions.supplement:
A(disappointment)：语境句：To my great disappointment, the concert was canceled. 固定搭配：to one's disappointment, hide one's disappointment
B(fear)：语境句：She overcame her fear of the dark and walked into the room. 固定搭配：for fear of, out of fear
C(delight)：语境句：The children danced with delight when they saw the presents. 固定搭配：to one's delight, with delight
D(relief)：语境句：Much to my relief, the exam was easier than I expected. 固定搭配：much to one's relief, a sigh of relief

questions.explanation: 虽然常有对火灾的恐惧，但作者从未“想象”（imagined）过真的会发生这样规模的灾难。never had I imagined 意为“我从未想过”。
questions.supplement:
A(remembered)：语境句：I clearly remembered locking the door before I left. 固定搭配：remember doing sth, remember to do sth
B(imagined)：语境句：I never imagined that I would win the first prize in the competition. 固定搭配：imagine doing sth, beyond one's imagination
C(admitted)：语境句：The boy admitted breaking the window while playing football. 固定搭配：admit doing sth, admit one's mistake
D(reminded)：语境句：Please remind me to call my parents tonight. 固定搭配：remind sb of sth, remind sb to do sth

questions.explanation: 整个小镇被野火烧毁，这无疑是一场巨大的“灾难”（disaster），与上文呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(encounter)：语境句：His first encounter with the famous writer changed his life. 固定搭配：a close encounter, an unexpected encounter
B(campaign)：语境句：The government has launched a campaign to promote healthy eating. 固定搭配：an advertising campaign, launch a campaign
C(accident)：语境句：She was seriously injured in a car accident yesterday. 固定搭配：by accident, a traffic accident
D(disaster)：语境句：The earthquake was one of the worst natural disasters in history. 固定搭配：natural disaster, a total disaster

questions.explanation: 然而，这“恰恰”（exactly）是已经发生的事实。that is what exactly happened 强调不可想象的灾难确实降临了。
questions.supplement:
A(exactly)：语境句：That is exactly what I was trying to tell you earlier. 固定搭配：exactly the same, not exactly
B(eventually)：语境句：After a long journey, they eventually reached the top of the mountain. 固定搭配：eventually discover, eventually become
C(suddenly)：语境句：The sky turned dark, and suddenly it started to rain heavily. 固定搭配：stop suddenly, happen suddenly
D(usually)：语境句：I usually go for a run in the park on Sunday mornings. 固定搭配：as usually (常作 as usual), usually do

questions.explanation: 根据下文“As a journalist”（作为一名记者）可知，作者正在“报道”（covering）这场野火。cover 在新闻语境中意为“采访、报道”。
questions.supplement:
A(investigating)：语境句：The police are investigating the cause of the mysterious fire. 固定搭配：investigate a crime, investigate thoroughly
B(fighting)：语境句：Firefighters have been fighting the blaze for over ten hours. 固定搭配：fight against, fight for
C(covering)：语境句：The reporter was assigned to cover the presidential election. 固定搭配：cover a story, cover an event
D(watching)：语境句：We sat by the lake, watching the sun go down. 固定搭配：watch out for, keep watching

questions.explanation: 朋友们发短信给作者，因为她在现场，所以是请她帮忙“查看/核查”（check）他们的房子是否还在。
questions.supplement:
A(check)：语境句：Please check your answers carefully before handing in the paper. 固定搭配：check out, double check
B(guess)：语境句：I can only guess what he is going to do next. 固定搭配：take a guess, make a guess
C(determine)：语境句：The police are trying to determine the exact time of the accident. 固定搭配：determine the cause, be determined to do
D(tell)：语境句：It is hard to tell the difference between the twin brothers. 固定搭配：tell the truth, tell apart

questions.explanation: 作者作为记者能在这个熟悉的家乡运用自己的专业技能与他人建立联系并帮忙分享故事，她从这种职业使命中感受到了一种“美好的”（beautiful）东西。
questions.supplement:
A(beautiful)：语境句：It is a beautiful thing to see people helping each other in times of need. 固定搭配：a beautiful mind, look beautiful
B(hopeful)：语境句：I am hopeful that we will find a solution to this problem soon. 固定搭配：be hopeful about, remain hopeful
C(frightening)：语境句：It was a frightening experience to be lost in the deep forest. 固定搭配：extremely frightening, look frightening
D(annoying)：语境句：The continuous noise outside the window was really annoying. 固定搭配：find it annoying, highly annoying

questions.explanation: 结合上文记者报道新闻的工作属性，作者在用她的工具来帮助“分享”（share）这个关于家乡火灾的故事给更多人。
questions.supplement:
A(witness)：语境句：We were fortunate enough to witness the historic moment. 固定搭配：witness an event, bear witness to
B(share)：语境句：He is always willing to share his learning experience with others. 固定搭配：share sth with sb, share a story
C(make)：语境句：It takes time and effort to make a difference in the world. 固定搭配：make a living, make sense
D(change)：语境句：Reading widely can totally change your perspective on life. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better

questions.explanation: 此处用 but 转折，表示报道这个故事同样令人情绪激动，因为在当时那个瞬间，你无法真正地“保护”（protect）这座小镇免受火灾侵袭。此题对比了记者的旁观报道与本地人面对家园被毁的无力感。
questions.supplement:
A(understand)：语境句：It took me a long time to fully understand what she meant. 固定搭配：fully understand, come to understand
B(protect)：语境句：We should take immediate action to protect the environment from pollution. 固定搭配：protect... from..., environmental protection
C(record)：语境句：The machine is designed to record the heart rate of the patient. 固定搭配：set a record, break a record
D(access)：语境句：Students can access a wealth of information through the school library. 固定搭配：have access to, gain access to

questions.explanation: 看着自己如此熟悉、承载童年记忆的家乡被大火烧毁，做这份报道工作不仅是责任，也是她在经历失去家乡的“痛苦的”（painful）过程的一部分。
questions.supplement:
A(worrying)：语境句：There is a worrying trend of youngsters spending too much time online. 固定搭配：a worrying sign, deeply worrying
B(awkward)：语境句：There was an awkward silence when he asked that personal question. 固定搭配：an awkward situation, feel awkward
C(painful)：语境句：It was a painful decision, but she had to quit her job for her health. 固定搭配：a painful experience, painful memories
D(boring)：语境句：The lecture was so boring that some students fell asleep. 固定搭配：extremely boring, find sth boring

questions.explanation: 尽管小镇被毁，失去了一切，但人们依然都在，彼此相互支持，这展现了灾后重建的希望，也是我们“继续前行”（moving forward）的全部意义所在。
questions.supplement:
A(giving in)：语境句：Despite the great difficulties, he never considered giving in. 固定搭配：give in to, never give in
B(sitting back)：语境句：You can't just sit back and wait for success to come to you. 固定搭配：sit back and relax, sit back and watch
C(holding on)：语境句：Please hold on a moment while I transfer your phone call. 固定搭配：hold on to, hold on tight
D(moving forward)：语境句：We must forget the past mistakes and keep moving forward. 固定搭配：move forward, push forward

section_2_word_form.passage:
Taoping Qiang Village is well known as the mysterious "Eastern Castle" because of its typical Qiang-style architecture [56] its complicated road structure.

The Taoping Watchtowers of different heights and shapes stand in the village. The architectural complex is the [57] (combine) of stone towers and houses. They were constructed with earth, stones, hemp and wood, some of [58] were constructed only with earth and wood. The [59] (solid) built towers and houses are still in good condition after many earthquakes.

There are alleyways (小巷) between the walls of the houses in the village. [60] some houses built over those alleyways, more alleyways have appeared, [61] (make) the whole alleyway structure more complicated. Walking in the alleyways, people feel [62] (they) transcending (超越) time and space.

It's amazing that the Taoping Watchtowers [63] (build) without any drawings, measurements and calculations then, yet they are well-structured, solid and unique. The watchtowers are a wonder of the history of world architecture, which attract a number of tourists from home and abroad [64] (admire) them.

Under the earth, there are many water channels covered by earth and stones. There are some [65] (move) stones which have been placed at certain distances, which help people to get water easily. The convenient and secret water channels serve as a water-net that reaches every watchtower, providing a large living space for the villagers, especially during wartime.

questions.explanation: 空格连接两个名词短语“typical Qiang-style architecture”和“its complicated road structure”，表示并列关系，因此填并列连词 and。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：The village is famous for its history and beautiful scenery. 固定搭配：and so on, both... and...

questions.explanation: 空格前有定冠词 the，后有介词 of，需要填入名词形式。combine 的名词形式为 combination，表示“石塔和房屋的结合体”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(combination)：语境句：The dish is a perfect combination of sweet and sour flavors. 固定搭配：in combination with, a combination of。原词combine其它变形：combined(adj.), combine with(v. 搭配)

questions.explanation: 逗号后是非限制性定语从句，补充说明前面的“houses and towers”，介词 of 后需接关系代词 which 指代事物（不能填 them，否则前后缺乏连词）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(which)：语境句：He bought a lot of books, some of which were written in English. 固定搭配：all of which, none of which

questions.explanation: 此处修饰后面的过去分词 built（被建造得），需要用副词形式，因此将形容词 solid 变为 solidly（坚固地）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(solidly)：语境句：The bridge is solidly built and can withstand severe storms. 固定搭配：solidly built, stand solidly。原词solid其它变形：solidify(v.), solidarity(n.)

questions.explanation: 此处考查 with 的复合结构“With + 宾语(some houses) + 宾补(built over those alleyways)”作伴随或原因状语。句首需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(With)：语境句：With the problem solved, we all felt relieved. 固定搭配：begin with, deal with

questions.explanation: 此处表示前面的情况导致了自然而然的结果，需用现在分词作结果状语，故填 making。
questions.supplement: 正确形(making)：语境句：The heavy rain lasted for days, making the river rise dangerously. 固定搭配：make a living, make up。原词make其它变形：maker(n.), made(adj.)

questions.explanation: 句意为“人们感觉自己超越了时空”。主语是 people，当宾语与主语是同一群体时，需使用反身代词 themselves。feel oneself doing sth 为常见用法。
questions.supplement: 正确形(themselves)：语境句：The children enjoyed themselves at the amusement park. 固定搭配：by themselves, help themselves to。原词they其它变形：their(pron.), them(pron.), theirs(pron.)

questions.explanation: 主语 The Taoping Watchtowers 是复数，与 build 之间是动宾（被动）关系，且句末有时间状语 then 指向过去，因此使用一般过去时的被动语态 were built。
questions.supplement: 正确形(were built)：语境句：These ancient temples were built more than a thousand years ago. 固定搭配：build up, build on。原词build其它变形：building(n.), builder(n.)

questions.explanation: 此处表示吸引国内外大量游客来此地的目的（为了欣赏它们），故用动词不定式 to admire 作目的状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to admire)：语境句：People gathered around the artist to admire his wonderful painting. 固定搭配：admire sb for sth, to admire。原词admire其它变形：admiration(n.), admirable(adj.)

questions.explanation: 修饰名词 stones（石头），根据后文“help people to get water easily”可知，这些石头是可以移动的，故用形容词 movable（可移动的活动石块）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(movable)：语境句：All the furniture in this modern apartment is movable to save space. 固定搭配：movable property, movable objects。原词move其它变形：movement(n.), moving(adj.), moved(adj.)
